name: Apper
description: Apper is an AI app builder that turns prompts into working apps with a built-in database, letting you manage app tables and records.

events.d: List records, search them with filters, or get one record by ID from a chosen table.
Update fields of an existing record in a chosen app table.
Create a record in a chosen app table, filling in its fields.
Permanently delete one or more records by ID from a chosen table.
Retrieve a list of apps in your Apper account.
Retrieve tables for a selected app; optionally choose which table fields to return.
